scope: Read-only inspection of already cached Jardulik app media; counts refer to unique files, not people. No new upstream requests.

method.remote: Python 3 stdlib: inspect complete RIFF/WebP chunks EXIF/XMP/ICCP; TIFF byte order, IFD0, ExifIFD, GPSIFD and linked IFDs; GPS validated as nonempty latitude/longitude DMS rationals with N/S/E/W refs, finite bounds and nonzero pair. JPEG APP0..APP15/COM and PNG chunks also supported but absent in this cache. No embedded values printed.
method.source_integrity: Each cached whole file SHA-256 matched its 64-hex filename.
method.gps_association: Read-only SQLite aggregate join media_jobs to versions; only distinct profile count and file-role counts returned.

client_bundle.crop_helper: vX uses canvas.drawImage then pX(canvas.toBlob), default image/jpeg quality0.92, maximum dimension1600; creates a new File.
client_bundle.webp_conversion: UY calls /photos/finalize-convert-to-webp and VY wraps returned blob as image/webp.

conclusions: Metadata is not removed unconditionally: cached files retain EXIF, ICC, and two files retain valid nonzero GPS coordinate pairs.
All388 unique cached media files are WebP by magic, including the two extensionless files previously described as JPEG.
The two GPS-bearing files are associated with one upstream profile and consist of one photos file and one miniPhotos file.
The two files in the inspected original-profile ZIP have no EXIF or GPS and each has a456-byte ICC profile.
limits: Existing cache is a sample, not a statement about every account or photo in the service.
No original-upload-versus-download control was performed; the exact client/server stage that retained or removed metadata is unproven.
Static bundle code establishes available conversion paths, not that every historical upload used them.
File-level EXIF presence does not imply camera, GPS, or date fields are present; their counts are reported separately.
privacy: Only aggregates, formats, dimensions of the two supplied archive images, public code references and tool names retained; no coordinates, people names, profile IDs, source-photo hashes, camera values, or tokens included.
